claim: The author's own interrupt spec: 4 IRQs per frame, one flagged as VBLANK — the root of the 59.886 Hz timebase.

corroboration.note: MAME hardware header: 12.096MHz master -> HSYNC=XTAL/256/3=15.75kHz -> VSYNC=HSYNC/263=59.88593Hz (MAME hedges the divisor, "could be /262" — open question 1). Three-way corroborated in brief.md §3 alongside the GTIME timer-wrap arithmetic and the scanline-timer IRQ generation.

claim: The IRQ handler distinguishes the VBLANK-flagged interrupt with BIT ENDSCN / BVS.
Only the VBLANK-flagged IRQ increments SYNC and the 16-bit FRAME counter.

claim: Rev 1's mainloop gates on SYNC: LSR SYNC / BCC spin-wait.
Rev 4's mainloop gates on SYNC identically.
Immediately after clearing SYNC, the mainloop pets the watchdog.
GTIME, the BCD game-time counter, increments (SED/CLD-wrapped) when FRAME's low byte wraps, every 256 frames.
GTIME's equate comment: game time in 4-second increments.
The self-test doc corroborates: average game time accurate to four seconds.
